If I were starting a brand-new Etsy shop in 2026, I already know EXACTLY what I would do. And more importantly, I know the order I would do it in. 👀 Most Etsy sellers have an idea of what they should be doing. The problem is they’re trying to do everything at once or doing the right things in the wrong order. Here’s the order I would follow: 1 - Pick a customer, not a niche. 2 - Build your product mix around that customer. 3 - Map out what they could need across different stages of their life. 4 - Blend hands-on products with products that are easier to fulfill. 5 - Publish 5–10 listings a day for 30 days. 6 - Build customer-focused SEO into your listings. 7 - Use Pinterest as another traffic source. 8 - Spend 10 minutes a day in Facebook groups where your customers already are. 9 - Respond quickly to Etsy messages and create an amazing customer experience. 10 - Refine your product mix using the data you’ve collected. 11 - Bring in support to take repetitive tasks off your plate. 12 - Expand beyond Etsy once you have a proven system. 13 - Use Instagram to build a deeper relationship with your audience. 14 - Hand off packaging and fulfillment so you can focus on product development and strategy. The biggest takeaway? The order matters. You don’t need to try every Etsy strategy at once. You need to know what deserves your attention NOW and what can wait.
